identity.name: Ballon Bleu de Cartier
identity.one_liner: Cartier's round sports-dress case, defined by a blue cabochon-set crown protected by an arched guard rather than by any bezel detail.

narrative.story: Cartier launched the Ballon Bleu in 2007 as a round case sitting apart from its rectangular Tank and older Santos lines, distinguished by a curved crown guard set with a blue synthetic spinel cabochon. The 42mm size sits at the top of a range that also runs smaller, and the line has become one of Cartier's standard round-case options alongside the far older Pasha.
narrative.collector_notes: Case-back and crown-guard finishing has changed subtly across production years; check that the cabochon crown itself is original and undamaged, since it is a common wear point from repeated winding and setting.
